question: Among female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics, find the one with the highest Speed attribute and return her full name along with how many female Dark Horse heroes share her eye color.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_hero AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_020 AS full_name, s.XCL_022 AS eye_color_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.full_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(s2.XCL_018)
        FROM superhero s2
        INNER JOIN gender g2 ON s2.XCL_021 = g2.XCL_007
        INNER JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.XCL_026 = p2.XCL_014
        WHERE g2.XCL_008 = 'Female'
          AND p2.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
          AND s2.XCL_022 = th.eye_color_id) AS hero_count
FROM top_hero th

WITH top_hero AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_020 AS full_name, s.XCL_022 AS eye_color_id
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.full_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(s2.XCL_018)
        FROM superhero s2
        INNER JOIN gender g2 ON s2.XCL_021 = g2.XCL_007
        INNER JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.XCL_026 = p2.XCL_014
        WHERE g2.XCL_008 = 'Female'
          AND p2.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
          AND s2.XCL_022 = th.eye_color_id) AS hero_count
FROM top_hero th
